title: 时间状语从句

examples.en: I was reading when he came in.
examples.zh: 他进来的时候我正在看书。

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.
examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。

guess.question: “我一到家就给你打电话”，as soon as 后面该用什么时态？

options.text: 一般现在时：as soon as I get home（主将从现）
options.feedback: 对！时间状语从句里用现在时表示将来的动作。

options.text: 将来时：as soon as I will get home
options.feedback: 不对——时间状语从句里不能用 will 表示将来。

options.text: 过去时：as soon as I got home
options.feedback: 不对——这里说的是还没发生的将来动作。

rule.rule: when / while / as 引导时间状语从句（while 只接持续性动作）；not … until 表示“直到……才”；as soon as 表示“一……就”；主句将来时，从句用一般现在时
rule.formula: ① when 可接短暂或持续动作；while 只接持续性动作（常用进行时）　② not … until：He didn't leave until I came.　③ as soon as：主将从现　④ 主将从现：I'll tell him when he comes.

anchors.en: I was doing my homework when the phone rang.
anchors.zh: 电话响的时候我正在写作业。

anchors.en: I'll write to you as soon as I arrive there.
anchors.zh: 我一到那儿就给你写信。

trap.wrong: I'll tell him when he will come.
trap.right: I'll tell him when he comes.
trap.why: 时间状语从句里用一般现在时表将来，不用 will。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——when / as soon as / until 引导的从句一律“主将从现”。

check.stem: I ____ you as soon as I ____ there.

options.distractor: 主句要用将来时，从句不能用

check.stem: He ____ go to bed ____ his mother came back.

options.distractor: came 是过去时，主句也要用过去时

check.explanation: 直到妈妈回来才睡：didn't … until。

options.text: I'll call you when I get home.
He didn't leave until I came back.
I'll tell him as soon as he will come.
While I was sleeping, the phone rang.

check.explanation: as soon as 从句要用一般现在时：as soon as he comes。
